name: Execution Of Non-Existing File
description: Checks whether the image specified in a process creation event is not a full, absolute path (caused by process ghosting or other unorthodox methods to start a process)
author: GAI_CTI
query: (NOT process.executable:*\\*) AND (NOT ((NOT _exists_:process.executable) OR (process.executable:(\- OR "")) OR ((process.executable:(System OR Registry OR MemCompression OR vmmem)) OR (process.command_line:(Registry OR MemCompression OR vmmem)))))
